-h.text:
Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into the "Add music" block & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! If you're unsure, testing is recommended.

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Sonic Shuffle, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for other types of music like "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, Flash/HTML5 game music, Miitopia music, FNF music & non-looping music. 

Burgnew_On_A_Laptop recommends you please don't add any more than around 80 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
